items.quote: Which the LORD commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.
items.claim: The LORD commanded the system of offerings and laws to Moses at Mount Sinai, establishing when the Israelites were to perform their ritual oblations.
items.mechanism: offerings/oblations (burnt offering, meat offering, sin offering, trespass offering, consecrations, peace offerings)
